name: comebye-coord-window
description: Early access, for a coordinator: past a size, keep the comebye digest plus the last turns in place, with no /clear. Beside coord-reset, which stays the fallback.

keep_turns.title: Turns to keep
keep_turns.description: How many of the latest prompts (with everything after them) stay when the window is trimmed.

trim_tokens.title: Trim above (tokens)
trim_tokens.description: Trim when the last request read more than this many tokens. Each trim rewrites the prompt cache once, so this is a step, not a per-turn cost.

cooldown_minutes.title: Minutes between trims
cooldown_minutes.description: Never trim twice within this long.
